task: Memoria live-transcription pipeline evaluated on AMI headset mix

parameters.diarization_call: Sortformer streaming (generate_stream file mode, memory-bounded replica), chunk 5.0 s, spkcache 188, fifo 188, right context 1 frame, frame 0.08 s, threshold 0.5

primary_der.reference: AMI segments with >=1 lexical word, same-speaker gap<=0.3 s merged

text_normalisation: Symmetric text normalisation for reference and hypothesis words.
NFKC, lowercase, typographic apostrophes -> ', non-lexical {tags} dropped, sentence punctuation and
underscores deleted (AMI spells acronyms T_V_ -> tv), any other symbol (hyphen, slash, ...) separates
tokens (uh-huh -> uh huh, user-friendly -> user friendly), leading/trailing apostrophes stripped.
No number, spelling or contraction expansion.
parameters.audio: AMI Mix-Headset 16 kHz mono; annotations AMI manual v1.6.2 (NXT)
parameters.selection_rule: shortest complete meetings (<= requested n), >= 4 teams

app_generate_probe.note: app-literal diar.generate() (one-shot) vs streaming on the same excerpts; excerpt DER over the excerpt only, so few-speaker excerpts are noisy

stream_verification.note: stock generate_stream is deterministic run-to-run (checked: identical output twice); the replica's conv pre-encode is computed in blocks, whose float32 results differ from the one-shot pre-encode by ~1e-4 (relative ~1e-6); this perturbation is amplified by the speaker-cache selection, so the two outputs agree closely but not bit-exactly.
